== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Duskwinder is a type of [[Kameira]] characterized as a twenty-foot-long winged serpent. It possesses bronze, armor-like [[scales]] and a spiked tail, utilizing three forked tongues to sense its surroundings. This creature is known to be highly predatory, capable of tracking the scent of [[blood]] with extreme speed. It undergoes growth by shedding its skin, a process that leaves behind material used in various crafts. Driven by a deep-seated [[Intent]], the Duskwinder is motivated by a singular, relentless desire to hunt and kill the individual responsible for its mother's death.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|These creatures are known to unwrap themselves from trees. They possess shed skin during their infancy that is utilized in the construction of handguns.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As a type of [[Kameira]], these creatures have the ability to smell [[blood]].}}
